verdict.rationale: Brave publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages (suggestions, spell check, rich search, local POIs, POI descriptions) and copy-paste curl examples. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable requests, and no public OpenAPI spec was found for loading into third-party explorers. missing for 10: interactive 'try it' console with runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
